CORRECTIVE GENERATION — left view, exact mask-preserving recolour.
Output must be a native 1024 by 1024 pixel RGBA PNG, the SAME dimensions as image 1. Do not return 1254 by 1254 or any larger resolution. This is an existing technical image to recolour in place, not a new composition.

2. design_reference.png: colour/material reference only.
3. concept_crop.png: original colour/material reference only.

Replace ONLY the grey RGB surface colour of image 1 with matte albedo colour and material detail. COPY image 1's alpha without any changes, including the thin drips, openings, every shape edge and the exact outer outline. Leave every transparent background pixel transparent. Do not paint scattered or semitransparent pixels into the empty space. Keep the entire geometry at its original coordinates: x=68 through 955, y=389 through 634. The large empty margins are deliberate. Do not scale, crop, rotate, center or change any edge.

SURFACES: pale yellow crystalline acid crust along the upper shelf; bile-green / sulphur-yellow-green translucent acid on the guide's existing drips and coatings; dark violet roots on the angular root forms. Use the reference's material colours, with light pale yellow rather than metallic gold. Do not add any new drips, bubbles, rocks, details that change geometry, or shapes. Paint fine pigment texture inside the fixed shapes.

FLAT ALBEDO: uniform shadowless frontal illumination. Pure diffuse material colours. No specular glints, no glossy white highlights, no reflection, no cast shadow, no ambient occlusion, no rim light, no strong dark-to-light shading. Luminous acid is simply its bright local colour, not illuminated surroundings. There is NO glow halo. No environment, background, floor, text or watermark.
Deliver just the left painting in the exact guide silhouette, on a 1024x1024 transparent canvas.
